title: QGIS 3D: Reality Capture, Animation & More
content: Lutra Consulting and North Road are crowdfunding the next round of QGIS 3D work. The two main features are Gaussian splatting, so you can view reality capture data alongside your GIS layers, and animation for 2D and 3D maps. We'll also add atmospheric scattering, scene presets, identify and highlight in 3D, and gamepad navigation. Everything goes into QGIS, free for everyone. Pledges close on 7 December, and you can find out more on the campaign page.
